name: Smart Modal – Create Custom Popups with Trigger Options
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
The Smart Modal plugin makes it easy to create stunning and engaging popups to display titles, content, or links. Built specifically for Gutenberg, this plugin provides users with flexibility in design and usage, and ensures a smooth integration with the block editor.

Smart Modal is an ideal tool for highlighting unique content, quickly sharing links, and increasing user engagement. From new to experienced developers, users of all skill levels can use it thanks to its user-friendly interface and easy setup process.

Smart Modal Features

  • Built for Gutenberg: Design beautiful popups right in the block editor — no code, no page reloads, no extra tools.
  • Any Block, Inside a Popup: Flip the content to the block editor and drop in anything — images, forms, videos, columns, buttons and beyond.
  • Triggers That Convert: Fire modals on click, page load, time delay, scroll depth, exit-intent, inactivity, element-in-view, any element click, page-view count, or time on site.
  • Show It to the Right People: Target by device, new vs returning visitors, URL parameters and schedules — with frequency capping so you never annoy anyone.
  • More Than a Modal: Choose a centered modal, a slide-in corner popup, a top/bottom notification bar, or a fullscreen takeover — with size presets and overlay blur.
  • Motion That Pops: Fade, slide from any direction, zoom, bounce, and flip entrance animations with full duration control.
  • Style Without Limits: Fine-tune every detail from the block sidebar, add per-block Custom CSS, and auto-close with an optional countdown.
  • Open It Your Way: Trigger from a button, text link, or image with an optional icon — or pin a floating launcher to any screen corner.
  • Flawless on Every Screen: Fully responsive width and max-height with smooth scrolling on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • Accessible by Default: ESC-to-close, smart focus handling, and ARIA dialog attributes built right in.
  • A Dashboard You’ll Actually Use: A modern admin hub with step-by-step guides (Gutenberg, Shortcode, Elementor, PHP), live demos, changelog, and one-click docs & support.
  • Use It Everywhere: Reuse modals as many times as you like, on any post, page, or template — completely unlimited.

🚀 Upgrade to Smart Modal Pro

Everything above is free. Go Pro to unlock server-side targeting and conversion tools:

  • Site-wide Auto-Display: Show a modal automatically across your whole site — no shortcode or block placement needed.
  • Page & Post Targeting: Include or exclude by specific page/post ID, post type, homepage, blog page, search, and 404 — all server-side.
  • User Targeting: Show or hide popups by login status (logged-in / logged-out) and by specific user roles.
  • Combine Multiple Triggers: Open on ANY of several triggers at once with OR logic (e.g. exit-intent OR 60% scroll).
  • Countdown Timer: Add urgency inside the modal — a fixed deadline or an evergreen per-visitor timer.
  • Custom Close Icon: Move the close icon to any corner or just outside the box, and use your own image.

👉 Get Smart Modal Pro

How to use Smart Modal

  • First, install the Smart Modal plugin from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Add the Block Name from the block category called “widgets” in the Gutenberg editor.
  • You can change block settings from the right-side settings sidebar.

  • Enjoy!

  • For installation help click on Installation Tab

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For Smart Modal
  3. Click on the Smart Modal to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the Smart Modal plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the smart-modal.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the smart-modal plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse a block?

You can use unlimited times as you want.

Can I put other blocks (forms, images, videos) inside the modal?

Yes. In the block’s General settings set Modal Content to “Block Editor”, then add any Gutenberg blocks inside the modal right in the editor canvas — images, forms, videos, columns, buttons and more. The classic Title & Text mode is still available, so existing modals keep working exactly as before.

What trigger options are available?

On click, on page load, on time delay, on scroll depth, on exit-intent, on inactivity, when an element scrolls into view, when any element on the page is clicked (custom selector), after N page views, and after a set time on site.

Can I control who sees the modal and how often?

Yes. Under Display Rules you can limit by device (desktop/tablet/mobile), new vs returning visitor, frequency capping (show X times then pause for N days), a URL parameter, and a campaign schedule (start/end date-time).

What display styles can the modal use?

A centered modal, a slide-in corner popup, a top/bottom notification bar, or fullscreen — with size presets, overlay blur, and fade/slide/zoom/bounce/flip entrance animations. You can also pin a floating trigger button to any screen corner.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here
sections.changelog:
1.4.0 – 30 October, 2026

  • Fix: Modal not opening on the front end due to a React version conflict.
  • Fix: Fatal error when Smart Modal Pro is activated alongside the free version.
  • Fix: Frequency cap and show-once limits now persist across pages for modals added via shortcode.

1.3.0 – 23 July, 2026

  • New: Modern admin dashboard — a Welcome page with a getting-started guide (Gutenberg, Shortcode, Elementor, PHP), live demos, and changelog.
  • New: One-click access to documentation and support from the dashboard.
  • New: “Go Pro!” and “Dashboard” quick links on the Plugins page, plus Docs & Demos row links.

1.2.0 – 21 July, 2026

  • New: InnerBlocks support — set modal content to “Block Editor” and add any Gutenberg blocks (images, forms, videos, columns…) inside the popup.
  • New: Advanced triggers — scroll depth, exit-intent, inactivity, element-in-view, click any element (custom selector), after N page views, and time on site.
  • New: Display rules / targeting — device visibility, new vs returning visitor, frequency capping, URL-parameter targeting, and campaign scheduling.
  • New: Display modes — slide-in corner popup, notification bar (top/bottom), and fullscreen, plus modal size presets and overlay blur.
  • New: Animation library — slide (4 directions), zoom, bounce, and flip, in addition to fade / slide-up.
  • New: Floating trigger button that can be pinned to any screen corner.
  • Compatible: Existing modals keep working unchanged; content defaults to the classic Title & Text mode.

1.1.0 – 20 July, 2026

  • New: Trigger options – open on click, page load, or time delay.
  • New: “Show once per session” and URL hash deep-link trigger.
  • New: Fade / slide-up entrance animation with duration control.
  • New: Modal position control (center/top/bottom), max-height with scroll, and z-index control.
  • New: Button, text link, or image as the modal trigger element, with optional icon.
  • New: Button hover color, close icon size, title spacing, and 3 style presets.
  • New: Auto-close with optional countdown, secondary dismiss button, and ESC-to-close.
  • New: Per-block Custom CSS field.
  • Improved: Accessibility – ARIA dialog attributes, focus handling, keyboard support.
  • Fixed: Description output no longer nested inside an invalid

<

p> tag.
* Fixed: Shortcode input sanitized to prevent invalid/unauthorized post output.
* Security: Modal description and Custom CSS are now sanitized on the server before output.
* Fixed: Text domain mismatches across settings labels corrected to “smart-modal”.

1.0.5 – 25 April, 2025

  • Compatible with WordPress 6.8;

1.0.4 – 12 April, 2025

  • Changed the default text and block title.

1.0.3 – 28 Jan, 2025

  • Close Icon Problem solve

1.0.2 – 15 Jan, 2025

  • new feature add – title tag

1.0.1 – 12 Jan 2025

  • Some issues fixed.

  • Initial Release
